content.json:
## Meternaut AI security

What guards Meternaut's models and agents, and what it saw. Four parts: **who called the AI Gateway** and what it refused (the gateway's own telemetry), **the harness** around the agents and **the app's own daily drift check** (lines that the cases app logs), and **what Azure Policy says** about the project's resource group. Nothing on this page changes Azure, and nothing on it holds a prompt or an answer: the gateway sends metadata only.

The gateway's part stays empty until the gateway's telemetry is on (the Hub action `gateway-telemetry`). The independent drift check, which reads Azure itself and does not depend on the app, runs in GitHub Actions (`tools/drift-check.py`) and shows its result on the page of its run.

If a table says "Query failed" or "could not connect to server": the portal reads this data from your browser, and a network that resolves the Azure Monitor query addresses to a private IP address cannot reach it. That is the network, not the query.

content.title: The AI Gateway in the time range: calls, blocked prompts, errors
content.query:
OTelSpans
| where Kind =~ 'Server' and tostring(Attributes['http.route']) contains '/models/'
| extend Status = coalesce(toint(Attributes['http.response.status_code']), toint(Attributes['http.status_code']), toint(ResultCode))
| summarize ['Calls in the range'] = count(), Answered = countif(Status between (200 .. 299)), ['Blocked or limited (403, 429)'] = countif(Status in (403, 429)), ['Other client errors'] = countif(Status in (400, 401, 404)), ['Server errors'] = countif(Status >= 500), Callers = dcount(tolower(tostring(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.identity.claims.oid'])))

content.title: Each caller and the alias it asked for: calls, refusals, errors and latency
content.query:
let callers = datatable(Oid: string, Caller: string) [ __CALLERS__ ];
OTelSpans
| where Kind =~ 'Server' and tostring(Attributes['http.route']) contains '/models/'
| extend Oid = tolower(tostring(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.identity.claims.oid'])), Alias = tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.request.model']), Status = coalesce(toint(Attributes['http.response.status_code']), toint(Attributes['http.status_code']), toint(ResultCode))
| lookup kind=leftouter callers on Oid
| extend Caller = iff(isempty(Caller), iff(isempty(Oid), 'no identity in the telemetry', strcat('not on the access list, ', substring(Oid, 0, 8))), Caller)
| summarize Calls = count(), Answered = countif(Status between (200 .. 299)), Refused = countif(Status in (403, 429)), ['Client errors'] = countif(Status in (400, 401, 404)), ['Server errors'] = countif(Status >= 500), ['Median ms'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 0), ['95th percentile ms'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0) by Caller, Alias
| order by Caller asc, Alias asc

content.title: Tokens that the model service reported, for each caller and hour
content.query:
let callers = datatable(Oid: string, Caller: string) [ __CALLERS__ ];
OTelLogs
| extend Oid = tolower(tostring(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.identity.claims.oid'])), Prompt = coalesce(tolong(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.client.usage.prompt_tokens']), tolong(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.client.usage.input_tokens'])), Completion = coalesce(tolong(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.client.usage.completion_tokens']), tolong(Attributes['azure.ai_gateway.client.usage.output_tokens']))
| where isnotnull(Prompt) or isnotnull(Completion)
| lookup kind=leftouter callers on Oid
| extend Caller = iff(isempty(Caller), iff(isempty(Oid), 'no identity in the telemetry', strcat('not on the access list, ', substring(Oid, 0, 8))), Caller)
| summarize Tokens = sum(coalesce(Prompt, long(0)) + coalesce(Completion, long(0))) by Caller, Hour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by Hour asc

content.title: Which gateway policy ran on the requests that ended in a refusal (a policy span and a 4xx on the same trace)
content.query:
let requests = OTelSpans
| where Kind =~ 'Server' and tostring(Attributes['http.route']) contains '/models/'
| project TraceId, Status = coalesce(toint(Attributes['http.response.status_code']), toint(Attributes['http.status_code']), toint(ResultCode));
OTelSpans
| extend PolicyType = tostring(Attributes['azure.apim.policy.type']), ErrorType = tostring(Attributes['error.type'])
| where isnotempty(PolicyType)
| where PolicyType !in ('forward-request', 'set-backend-service', 'llm-emit-token-metric', 'llm-emit-cost-metric')
| join kind=inner requests on TraceId
| summarize Requests = dcount(TraceId), ['Ending in 403 or 429'] = dcountif(TraceId, Status in (403, 429)), ['Ending in another 4xx'] = dcountif(TraceId, Status between (400 .. 499) and Status !in (403, 429)), ['Error types'] = make_set_if(ErrorType, isnotempty(ErrorType), 5), ['Last ran'] = max(TimeGenerated) by ['Policy that ran'] = PolicyType
| order by ['Ending in 403 or 429'] desc

content.title: Minutes in which a caller used at least __NEAR_PERCENT__ percent of the token limit or of the request limit
Trips of the agent harness (a limit, a check or a guard stopped an agent run; the line holds a reason code and hashes, no text of the estate)
content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message startswith 'harness.trip' or (Message startswith 'meternaut_event ' and Message contains '"type":"harness.trip"')
| project When = TimeGenerated, Line = substring(Message, 0, 300)
| order by When desc
| take 100

content.title: The last result of each control of the app's own daily drift check
content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith 'drift.pass' or Message startswith 'drift.fail' or Message startswith 'drift.unknown'
| extend Payload = parse_json(substring(Message, indexof(Message, ' ') + 1))
| extend Control = tostring(Payload.control), Layer = tostring(Payload.layer), State = tostring(Payload.state), Detail = tostring(Payload.detail), ReadAt = todatetime(Payload.readAt)
| where isnotempty(Control)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Layer, State, Detail, ReadAt) by Control
| project Control, Layer, State, Detail, ['Read at'] = ReadAt, Logged = TimeGenerated
| order by State asc, Control asc

content.title: Is the app's own drift check running? (an alert rule fires when no pass or fail line has been seen for __HEARTBEAT_HOURS__ hours)
content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith 'drift.pass' or Message startswith 'drift.fail' or (Message startswith 'meternaut_event ' and (Message contains '"type":"drift.pass"' or Message contains '"type":"drift.fail"'))
| summarize ['Last pass or fail line'] = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend ['Hours since'] = round(datetime_diff('minute', now(), ['Last pass or fail line']) / 60.0, 1)
| extend Verdict = case(isnull(['Last pass or fail line']), 'no pass or fail line in 30 days: the check has not reported yet, or it stopped', ['Hours since'] <= __HEARTBEAT_HOURS__, 'the check is running', 'the check is silent: more than __HEARTBEAT_HOURS__ hours')

content.title: Azure Policy on this resource group: resources by compliance state and effect (the view that the Foundry portal's Compliance page reads)
content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where resourceGroup =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP__'
| extend State = tostring(properties.complianceState), Effect = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionAction), Assignment = tostring(properties.policyAssignmentName), Resource = tostring(properties.resourceId)
| summarize Resources = dcount(Resource), Policies = dcount(strcat(Assignment, '/', tostring(properties.policyDefinitionReferenceId))) by State, Effect
| order by State asc, Effect asc

content.title: The alert rules of this resource group and whether they are on
content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules'
| where resourceGroup =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP__'
| project Rule = name, Enabled = tostring(properties.enabled), Severity = tostring(properties.severity), Every = tostring(properties.evaluationFrequency), Window = tostring(properties.windowSize)
| order by Rule asc
